pairing_rationale: Male and female parasite pools are distinct samples. Neither matching replicate numbers nor the shared generic BioSample establishes matched biological units across sex.
biological_unit_definition: Independently collected parasite pool and chromatin preparation, not an individual sequenced read, sequencing run or Input library.
biological_independence_status: The publications describe biological replication, including two male replicates, but an exact source-pool mapping for the two selected female libraries per stage has not been established. A shared BioSample is not evidence of either independence or pseudoreplication.

comparisons.instrument: Illumina HiSeq 2500 for all four IP libraries
comparisons.enrichment_review: FAVORABLE; FRiP and IDR do not establish biological independence

h3k27me3_qc.interpretation: Marked between-library variation requires review before inferential DB; no universal broad-mark FRiP pass threshold was imposed. Minimum-one regional inclusion is not replication certification.

confounding_and_scope_of_inference: The adult male-versus-female effect cannot be separated from sequencing instrument in the selected libraries. A group-only model would estimate a combined difference, not an isolated sex effect. Do not label deposited Adult libraries as paired or sexually mature paired worms; the publications describe unisexual infections and distinguish somatic differentiation from sexual maturity.
normalization_review: PENDING_IF_DB_BECOMES_ELIGIBLE; no claim of absolute occupancy, spike-in calibration or validated invariant regions.
